But I assumed it had long since gone the way of AIM and Skype, its manual turn-by-turn guidance made obsolete by big tech. Proof of life came in January 2025, when Donald Trump issued an executive order renaming the Gulf of Mexico the Gulf of America – a change Apple Maps and Google Maps promptly adopted, while MapQuest … did nothing.
